forum.title: Scrolling page during edit causes OP and other reply’s to be out of view
forum.best_answer_content: ​@Karl Yamashita , the issue has been fixed. Check whether it still occurs. Recommendation: clear the cached files from the browser first, and then log in.
forum.content_text:
I’ve noticed that when replying to a post that I had written a lot of text and added images. I expanded (red circle) the text area (blue area) to see everything. I needed to copy some text from the OP so I used the scroll bar (red rectangle) to view the first post.

But as you can see in green, it’s just a small area that can be seen and that is all that is seen during scrolling. The edit textbox stays in place and doesn’t scroll. If i expand the edit textbox even further, all of the green area is totally out of frame.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e08cf10a-4c20-4206-9167-6503d9107c43.jpg)
